title: CAT DASH
oneLiner: Leap over chasing dogs and sprint as far as your tiny paws can carry you!
mechanics: The cat runs automatically across a scrolling street.
Press A to jump over dogs and low obstacles.
Clear obstacles to earn points and collect fish for bonus score.
The pace steadily increases and collisions end the run.

controls.b: Dash briefly, if charged by collecting three fish

lose: The cat loses when it hits a dog or obstacle.
scoring: Score points for distance, with bonus points for collecting fish and clearing dogs.
